content.text: Utah State University sites use cookies. By continuing to use this site you accept our privacy and cookie policy. I agree Skip to content Campuses One program, two campuses. Logan Utah State University's main campus is located in Logan, Utah. The population of Logan is 132,000. Campus is situated on 400 acres of land, with 19,000 students enrolled. Aggies Elevated program capacity is limited to 5-7 students per cohort, ensuring a personalized and focused learning environment. For more information about Logan's campus, visit https://www.usu.edu/location/. Utah State University campus in Logan, Utah. Eastern Utah State University Eastern is located in Price, Utah. Price's population is 8,800. The campus is located on approximately 4 acres, equivalent to about two city blocks, with 1,500 students enrolled. The program capacity is limited to 5-7 students per cohort, providing a focused and personalized learning experience. For more information about Eastern's campus, visit https://eastern.usu.edu/about/. Utah State University Eastern campus in Price, Utah.
